readerQuestion: What changes when an AI app can keep working through a task instead of only replying in a chat?
verifiedScope: September10 developer public beta: OpenAI-managed Codex harness, developer supplies tools and chooses environment. Not a new consumer ChatGPT button.
Harness means the surrounding software that manages tools, work history, task coordination and recovery; do not imply the language model itself acquired guaranteed memory or autonomy.
Official overview explicitly prices model use, tools and hosted containers separately. Announcement no extra Agents API fee does not mean free or model tokens alone.

Official overview currently says United States data residency only and no Zero Data Retention, including when sandbox self-hosted. If discussed, attribute date and do not confuse chosen computing location with absence of retained API session data.
Hosted sandbox docs explicitly say completed turn does not guarantee every tool succeeded. Useful reader distinction: finished status versus actual result.
Network outbound enabled by default absent template policy; developer can disable/restrict. Do not describe sandbox as automatic prevention of all external actions.
editorialLimits: OpenAI launch customer testimonials are not an independent controlled comparison. Avoid promotional percentage improvements.
No claim a specific personal app already uses this API. Illustrative personal-life use must be clearly hypothetical and the real point an observable permission/result boundary.
Explain API briefly as a connection software makers use; do not burden ordinary reader with model/tool/configuration inventory.
Link current Working with AI 101 agents/output-checking section, already verified by actual browser from AskCA today.
Reopen sources at final drafting if dated freshness changes; this evidence does not admit any prose.
